# Joseph and Aseneth Chapter 8 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Greek MS | **Section:** Aseneth's Confession and Prayer for Mercy

---

**1** 'I am your servant, Lord — Pentephres' daughter, the great priest's child. But I was proud and arrogant, boasting in my wealth and my comfortable life.'

**2** 'I put my trust in my looks. I was full of myself, boasting in front of everyone: "Who compares to me?" And now look at me — humbled, brought down, alone and broken.'

**3** 'Have mercy on me, Lord. I am an orphan, abandoned, for my parents have disowned me — "Aseneth is no daughter of ours" — because I smashed their gods.'

**4** 'Everyone hates me. Even Pharaoh's son hates me because I turned him down and treated him with contempt.'

**5** 'I beg you, Lord. You alone are truly gracious and kind and gentle. Rescue me before some evil man gets hold of me.'

**6** 'Rescue me, Lord, before evil men drag me away. Save me the way a father saves his little child — for you are the great and powerful Father, full of compassion.'

**7** 'A father loves his child like his own life; a mother nurses her baby with total devotion. But you, Lord, are more compassionate than any father or mother.'

**8** 'Have mercy on me, Lord. See my suffering and my lowliness. Show me pity — the full measure of your mercy.'

**9** 'You are sweet, Lord. You are good and gentle — more patient and more merciful than any other god.'

**10** 'All Egypt's gods are ancient, grotesque, and dead — just wood and stone.'

**11** 'But you, Lord, are the living God. Your kingdom is eternal, your life never passes away, your years never end.'

**12** 'Have pity on me, Lord. I am broken and alone. In you alone do I find refuge.'

---
*PNEUMA: modern English; verse-only numbering.*
